questions.question: Which is correct: "their book" or "there book"?

points.text: "their book" - their shows possession (belonging to them)

questions.question: Spell the word meaning "to influence": affect or effect?

points.text: "affect" - affect is the verb meaning to influence

questions.question: What is the correct spelling: neccessary or necessary?
Add the suffix -ing to the word "hop" - what do you get?

points.text: hopping - double the consonant after a short vowel

questions.question: Complete this sentence: "You're going to lose / loose your keys."

points.text: lose - lose means to misplace; loose means not tight
